text:
maya: Heads-up, main CI is failing across multiple workflows — self-hosted runners returning KMS decrypt errors. Failing since ~10:02am. Anyone have context?
alex: saw a spike of 403s in runner logs earlier, might be the ephemeral creds dance after the pool rollout.
maya: stack: gha self-hosted -> secrets provider -> aws-kms. Error in log: ```Error: KMSDecrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: user arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ci-runner/... is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 (Service: AWSKMS; Status Code: 403)```
jamie: hmm we rotated the runner instance profile yesterday for least-privilege change. Did the KMS key policy get updated to include the new role?
maya: I didn't touch key policy. Could be the new instance profile name or session ARN changed.
alex: quick triage steps: 1) check `aws sts get-caller-identity` from a runner, 2) `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob` will reproduce the 403, 3) inspect key policy & IAM role binding.
jamie: i'll try an interactive runner to repro, ping me if you want me to run remote.
maya: can someone rerun the failing matrix while we debug? CI is blocking a release.
ops-bot: @ci-bot queued rerun for workflow #442 on main — started 10:07am (run id: 98765).
jamie: ran a quick repro, confirmed the session ARN is `arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ci-runner-v2/AWSIL...` — key policy still references `ci-runner` role (old name). That mismatch explains 403.
alex: ok that matches. Fix options: A) add new role ARN to key policy (quick), B) update instance profile back to previous name (rollback), C) grant decrypt via a kms:ViaService ACL for the runner VPC endpoint if appropriate.
maya: adding role to policy seems fastest. Can someone with KMS perms do it?
sre-oncall: I can patch the key policy, will add the new assumed-role ARN and deploy. Doing change now, will post diff.
ops-bot: @sre-oncall updated key policy for key/abcd-ef01 (change id: chg-2023-45) — rolled.
jamie: re-ran the repro `aws kms decrypt` and now it succeeds.
maya: thanks. Can we also open a follow-up to keep key policy synced with runner role name changes? Last thing we want is repeat outages.
alex: +1 — will create a short RFC: keep a mapping in infra repo, and add a check to the deploy pipeline to validate KMS key policies against expected principals.
maya: great. For now the queued CI rerun passed 10:12am, all green. Thanks everyone. :tada:
jamie: leaving a note in the release PR about the transient perm fix.
ops-bot: workflow #442 completed: success.
maya: closing this thread, will file the RFC.
